question: What special interview and documentation rules apply to minors and nightclub entertainers applying for an Occupational Permit?
answer: If you are a minor (below 18 years old) or a nightclub entertainer, masseur, or bar attendant aged 18-20, you are required to undergo an interview as part of the application process for an Occupational Permit. This is stated in [S1] and [S2] of the Business Bureau CGD_Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II.pdf.

ground_truth: Entertainers, masseurs, and bar attendants aged 18-20, or workers below 18, must present themselves for an interview and submit a PSA Birth Certificate, parent/guardian valid ID with appearance, notarized Affidavit of Consent, and City Health ID.
